parsed.why: No trans-specific offence; gender-identity anti-discrimination and hate-crime law, state detained official urging beheading. But dated LGBTQ-wide hostility, hate speech, inconsistent implementation and no documented social acceptance keep it mid-band.

No criminalisation and paper identity protections, but recurring violent attacks on public events with police failure to protect, state-cancelled screenings, activists chased, worsening monitor trend, and hostile attitudes.

State-imposed universal exposure: binary-only passport/visa markers, refusal and lifetime-fraud screening, confiscated passports, facility bans criminal in four states, documented custody abuse, allied travel advisories.

Bathroom access protected, gender-identity anti-discrimination and hate-crime coverage, functioning complaints body, no documented trans-targeting; only small, non-disaggregated hate-crime counts and thin trans-specific data.

Penal code articles reach trans visitors, no recognition, no registered organisations, no anti-discrimination or complaint route, documented party raids and official hostility; no later state enforcement sourced.
